manual.note: itch.io serves these free packs through 60-second signed links, so they cannot be fetched by address. Download each Standard zip from its page ("Download Now", then "No thanks, just take me to the downloads"), put it in assets-src/cache/quaternius-ual/ under the name below, and run npm run assets:fetch, which checks it against sources.lock.json and unpacks the files the build uses.
